Leadership rotated decisively out of Monday's small-cap/industrials catch-up trade and back into mega-cap tech/AI. Fresh, high-conviction sentiment catalyst reigniting the dominant market theme into a heavy AI-earnings week.
positions.driver: LONG TQQQ (3x Nasdaq-100), 100% capital. Today's clear leadership is mega-cap tech/AI (QQQ +2.1% vs IWM +0.86%), sparked by Palantir's blowout re-rating AI demand across the complex. Chose TQQQ over SOXL (3x semis): SOXL is higher-beta but already up ~10%+ intraday (MU +5% underlying) — violates the no-chasing rule — and carries concentrated single-name gap risk into AMD earnings tonight. TQQQ tracks a +2.1% underlying (not extended), spreads AMD-tonight exposure across 100 names for more downside protection, still captures AI leadership at 3x. Stop 65.81 (-10%). Runners-up: SOXL (passed — chasing extended semis + AMD risk); TNA (sold — small-cap leadership faded); MU/NVDA single names (passed — single-name overnight gap risk vs diversified index).
positions.risks: 3x magnifies reversals and the book holds overnight into AMD earnings (after close) plus SpaceX's first public print — an AMD miss could drag semis and gap the Nasdaq through the 65.81 stop before tomorrow's rotation. A hot JOLTS/jobs read or renewed oil spike could unwind the risk-on bid. Mitigant: entry tracks a +2.1% underlying (not chased), AMD is only ~1-2% of QQQ so a miss is cushioned vs SOXL, Palantir's blowout skews the AI read-through bullish, hard 10% stop + daily rotation cap loss.
